Dear Hiring Team,

The Full-Stack Developer Intern role fits my experience creating accessible web applications and building useful tools through coursework.

In CampusConnect, I created React and TypeScript components for event discovery and developed 12 REST endpoints with Node.js and Express. Those features connect directly to your need for user-facing development and API work.

My StudySpace project gave me experience with searchable listings, a Next.js interface, and MongoDB-backed APIs. I also added clear loading and error states and tested key flows with Jest.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute thoughtfully while learning from your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Kumar
